preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM parser WHERE dataset_name = 'lu_pep_grand_duke'

changeSet.sql:
INSERT INTO parser ( list_provider_id, name, description, dataset_name, source_id, plugin_id, plugin_url, data_source_type, parser_kind, source_location, parameters, refresh_hours, retention_months, licence, attribution, enabled, created_at ) SELECT p.id, 'PEP Luxembourg – Grand-Duc (Chef de l''État)', 'S.A.R. le Grand-Duc de Luxembourg, Chef de l''État (Maison grand-ducale, catégorie LU-a)', 'lu_pep_grand_duke', NULL, 'lu-pep-grand-duke', 'D:/test parser 2/plugins/swiftcheck-aml-lu-pep-grand-duke-0.0.1-SNAPSHOT.jar', 'HTTP_FILE', 'WEB_PAGE', 'https://monarchie.lu/fr/la-famille-grand-ducale/le-grand-duc', '{"sourceUrl": "https://monarchie.lu/fr/la-famille-grand-ducale/le-grand-duc", "includeFormer": "false", "yearsAfterEnd": "5"}', 168, 60, 'Données publiques officielles', 'Maison du Grand-Duc (monarchie.lu)', TRUE, NOW() FROM list_provider p WHERE p.code = 'LU-MONARCHIE';
INSERT INTO parser_coverage (parser_id, function_id) SELECT p.id, f.id FROM parser p JOIN pep_category cat ON cat.code = 'LU-a' JOIN pep_function f ON f.category_id = cat.id AND (f.label LIKE '%Grand-Duc%' OR f.id = 1) WHERE p.dataset_name = 'lu_pep_grand_duke';
